page_description

Explore genetic correlations between human and mouse phenotypes not just based on similar descriptions, but through shared genetic associations. Using PIGEAN, a new statistical approach, this module identifies mouse phenotypes that are enriched for genes linked to human phenotypes via GWAS and Orphanet data.
